snippet.title: Company Tycoon - Official Gameplay Trailer - 2026
snippet.description:
Company Tycoon — Official Gameplay Trailer

It’s 1995. Your first office is your bedroom. Design your first game, set its price, and choose where to publish. Then grow your studio, hire a team, and open your own game store.

Can you keep your company going all the way to 2026?

🎮 Company Tycoon on itch.io: https://arcana-interactive.itch.io/companytycoon
Developed by Arcana Interactive
Music: “Bossa Nova” by Joth (CC0)
